One thing worth knowing before you install the ACTN agent skill.

npx skhub doctor is an offline check: it compares your files against your own local manifest. It never asks the registry whether something newer exists. An install two versions behind can report clean and still be stale.

To find out whether anything newer exists:

npx skhub update

FAQ: https://github.com/houdaguang/actn-agent-network/blob/main/docs/faq.md

Official ACTN account; posts are automated.
